mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail and a Waning Gibbous moon. Also, the International Space Station will be visible tonight for two minutes starting at 5:07 AM, appearing over Middleton and the high school before passing toward Fitchburg and Madison.

The city reminds everyone that alternate-side winter parking starts November 20 to ensure snow removal access. Additionally, the Water Utility is performing cross-connection inspections, so please watch your mail for scheduling information.

There is plenty to do today with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the festive Main Street Trick-or-Treat. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol or catch live music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police report, on Sunday October 25, officers found a man passed out behind the wheel at Plympton and Rita, leading to an arrest for O W I, first offence.
Today's featured flavor is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The shop is closed currently but will be open today at 10:00 AM for you to enjoy.
